_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently (additive upsert by command — see deploy-global step 13) One PreToolUse process carries every shell policy gate: four DENIES (pip ban, package-manager mixing, lockfile deletion, protected environment branches) via exit 2, then the non-blocking pre-push quality-gate reminder. `permissionDecision: allow` is emitted only inside that push branch — never globally. Policy: CLAUDE.md > Python Dependency Management / Package Manager, git-workflow.md > Safety gates.
